notes: CJK coverage: zh-Hant/zh-Hans/Japanese/Korean paragraphs, CJK in heading/table/code block/list, full-width punctuation mixed with Latin, and one long unbroken CJK line (no spaces, opening of Lantingji Xu) with the marker 封装换行标记 inserted so it straddles a line wrap in the exported PDF: on the single A4 page produced, the line wraps after '...此地有崇山峻封装换' and continues '行标记岭茂林...', splitting the 6-character marker 3/3 across the wrap (封装换 | 行标记). The marker still matches as a whole under the contract's normalize-and-contains rule because PDFKit's page text join loses only the intervening newline, which normalize strips.
